reddit.title: Calculator's updated for the Nov 25 hotfix
reddit.body:
Nov 25 hotfixes are in and boomkins got a proper rework. Class stuff:

- **Druid** - Improved Wrath is now Starlight Wrath and also takes 0.1-0.5 sec off Starfire. Improved Moonfire is now Moon and Stars, 50/100% chance Starfire doesn't get pushed back. Improved Starfire is only 2 points now (8/15%). Eclipse also gives Wrath +7/13/20% crit all the time. Moonfury is gone, Dreamstate replaces it (Innervate someone else and you get 20-100% of it too). Moonkin Form gives +10% Arcane and Nature damage. If you had 3+ points in Improved Starfire your talents got reset.
- **Hunter** - pet melee crit was 0%, fixed. BM hawks were missing about 5% crit, fixed, and they follow your target properly now.
- **Paladin** - Exorcism can crit again, Judgements refresh from your attacks again. Oath of Light lasts 60 min.
- **Warlock** - pet melee crit fixed. Succubus/Incubus had 5% too much crit, fixed.
- **Shaman** - Chain Lightning eats Clearcasting now when you also have 5 Maelstrom stacks.
- **Rogue** - Poised drops properly when you Sap or Distract. Poisons and Blinding Powder are BoP for now while they fix a bug.
- **Warrior** - Weaponmaster comes back after dying in BGs.

Winners: Balance Druid (Moonkin Form, Eclipse, Starlight Wrath, Moon and Stars), BM Hunter hawks, Holy Paladin (Oath of Light).
Losers: nobody really. Moonfury's 10% just moved into Moonkin Form.

Both Balance builds are redone for the new tree. Moonkin takes Dreamstate (innervate your healer, get a full one yourself), leveling skips it. None of the other builds needed changing.

https://talentsmith.app/changes.html
